QuestInfo.name: Kidnapped!
QuestInfo.0: On the way to take #p2440000# away from town, Alpha and Beta ran into an ugly surprise...  #p2440000# and #p2440002# are missing! They raced to #b#p2440001##k to find out why.
QuestInfo.1: The truth is out. #p2440000# and #p2440002# didn't run away... They were kidnapped! With the Shadow Knights as the most likely culprit, the duo raced to #b#MDmap324090210##k to rescue their new panda friends.
QuestInfo.2: When they arrived at #MDmap324090210#, they found #p2440003# waiting for them! He even offered to let them take #p2440000# and #p2440002# and rejoin the Shadow Knights. He was being awfully friendly...

0.0: W-Wu Gong and Tae Soo are gone! If I'd seen the kidnappers, I would have busted their lips! It must've been all those weirdo tourists who were #rwearing red#k. They're lucky they didn't run into me.
0.1: Mu Gong would have seen them if he hadn't been off training. I didn't see them, but I bet they went north, to #b#MDmap324090210##k. I'd go up there myself, but I have lots of stuff to do...

npc.0: I saw them... I mean, SOMEBODY saw them headed to #b#MDmap324090210##k. Sorry I can't tag along to save the day.
